description: This PHP class defines the 'DisplayFieldGroup' entity for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations to map the class to the database table 'ohrm_display_field_group'. The class encapsulates properties including id, reportGroup, name, isList, and selectedDisplayFieldGroups, with corresponding getter and setter methods. It models the data structure for grouping display fields within reports.
external_methods: Doctrine ORM annotations: ORM\Table, ORM\Entity, ORM\Column, ORM\Id, ORM\GeneratedValue, ORM\ManyToOne, ORM\JoinColumn, ORM\OneToMany
